span.p:
Summary box is not a stored state.
Terminal workflows are immutable.
Retryable system failure retains state and job fence.

span.p:
Internal finalization only, no public publication.
Email retries follow independent delivery state (03b).
Viewed / reviewed activity does not approve.

svg.text: Workflow 2 of 2 — human gates, invalidation and terminal exits

g.text: T09 owns transition guards. Labels identify events / transition IDs; summary boxes are not stored states.
Human waits persist in Atlas. Email state is independent from approval state; a sent message is never an approval.
Design only. Full source transition tables are linked in edge-contract-crosswalk.json.
